verdict.rationale: The RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell is a physical workstation GPU that is always installed in the buyer's own machine, so 'self-hosting the core product' is a software deployment-model question that does not apply to this kind of product. The evidence about running AI workloads locally (e.g., docs-1, docs-10) describes workloads running on the card, not a self-hostable edition of the product. It therefore does not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
